name: SF_045 - Verify selected salary date option is retained correctly after network interruption
description: Verify selected salary date option remains intact when network interruption occurs during submission and user can successfully navigate to Work Experience page after network restoration. Note: Option is NOT retained after app relaunch — this is expected behavior.
